description:
Free, read-only check-up of a Decibel account (wallet or Trading Account address):
        margin buffer, distance to liquidation, positions without a stop-loss, fees,
        maker/taker share, win rate, realized result and funding of the last days, plus how
        it compares with the other accounts checked on Pitbi. No registration needed, nothing
        signed, the address is not stored.
name: check_account
